title: Pangilinan notes Cale88 ownership change after P1.25B in transactions

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Senator-Judge Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan questioned on Tuesday the change in Cale88 Foods Corp.’s ownership after Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) records allegedly showed over ₱1.25 billion in transactions from 2022 to 2025. Pangilinan recalled Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) testimony that lawyer Manases “Mans” Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, held 47.5 percent of Cale88 from 2021 through 2024. He noted, however, that Carpio’s name no longer appeared in the company’s 2025 General Information Sheet and was replaced instead by Pikimong Pikimong Philippines Corp.
